title: Give exported audit evidence a file and a verification command
goal: VC-201-079 is not delivered. AuditEvidence (crates/susi-gawd/src/audit_evidence.rs) exports an in-memory Vec<AuditSegment> and its verification is reachable only from Rust code: no CLI command writes an export to a file, reads one back, or verifies it, so a third party cannot independently verify evidence - which is the claim. The four distinct failures are real and well tested (vc_201_079_distinct_failures covers truncation, tampering, a missing segment and an unknown key), and redaction holds; what is missing is a serialized export (redacted body plus key ids and signature metadata), a command that verifies a file and reports each failure mode distinctly with a non-zero exit, and a test proving the file round-trip and every failure mode without exposing a secret.
